claims.text: Hotel Neri is in the heart of the Gothic Quarter, surrounded by the old Jewish quarter.

findings.quote: Situado en el corazón del Barrio Gótico y rodeado del antiguo barrio judío

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as hidden down a tiny, quiet alleyway off one of the prettiest squares in the Gothic Quarter.

findings.quote: hidden down a tiny, quiet alleyway off one of the prettiest squares in
Gothic Quarter, Hotel Neri is the choice for you.

claims.text: The palace's old courtyard was recovered.

findings.quote: siendo uno de ellos un magnífico palacio medieval del siglo XII, del que se recuperó el antiguo patio y se restauraron

claims.text: The sgraffito decorations found in the palace are considered among the most important in Barcelona.

findings.quote: siendo uno de ellos un magnífico palacio medieval del siglo XII, del que se recuperó el antiguo patio y se restauraron
los esgrafiados encontrados, considerados de los más importantes de la ciudad condal

claims.text: The hotel's interior design is by Virginia Figueras and Franco Corada.

findings.quote: El diseño interior integral del hotel, proyectado por Virginia Figueras y Franco Corada

claims.text: Rooms are decorated with photographs from the La Mirada Transeunte collection.

findings.quote: decoradas con fotografías de la colección La Mirada Transeúnte

claims.text: Classic rooms have views of the Gothic Quarter.

findings.quote: las habitaciones Classic tienen vistas al Barrio Gótico

claims.text: The Suite has a separate sitting area and keeps its original restored ceilings.

findings.quote: Con una zona de estar separada, la espaciosa habitación Suite mantiene los techos originales restaurados

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Junior Suite has views of Sant Felip Neri square.

findings.quote: The best room in the house is definitely the Junior Suite, with its views of the charming Sant Felipe Neri Square below.
findings.note: CNT states the Junior Suite views the square (official page mentions Gothic Quarter street views)

claims.text: A sleep preferences menu lets guests choose cotton, satin or linen sheets and down or hypoallergenic pillows.

findings.quote: The sleep preferences menu allows guests to choose from sheets made of cotton, satin, or linen as well as down or hypoallergnic pillows.

claims.text: Many of the natural stone bathrooms have both a bathtub and a rain shower.

findings.quote: Many of the peaceful, natural stone bathrooms have both a bathtub and rain shower.

claims.text: a Restaurant is located on Plaza Sant Felip Neri.

findings.quote: a Restaurant es el único restaurante ubicado en la Plaza
Sant Felip Neri de Barcelona.

claims.text: Hotel Neri occupies two historic buildings, one of them a 12th-century medieval palace.

findings.quote: el Hotel Neri ocupa dos históricos edificios,
siendo uno de ellos un magnífico palacio medieval del siglo XII

claims.text: Deluxe Terrace rooms have a terrace with a relaxation area and an outdoor bathtub.

findings.quote: Las habitaciones Deluxe Terraza presentan una armoniosa y relajante decoración en tonos cálidos y cuentan con una terraza que incluye zona de relax y bañera exterior

claims.text: The Deluxe Balcony room overlooks Plaza Sant Felip Neri and has a balcony.

findings.quote: Con vistas privilegiadas a la Plaza Sant Felip Neri, la habitación Deluxe Balcony es la única que permite asomarse a su balcón

claims.text: Roba Estesa is a rooftop terrace surrounded by greenery on the hotel's top floor.

findings.quote: En la última planta del hotel te espera Roba Estesa, un auténtico oasis urbano. Una discreta terraza rodeada de verde

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Roba Estesa rooftop is reserved for guests and private events.

findings.quote: The Roba Estesa rooftop has been converted into an opulently landscaped oasis
reserved just for guests and private events

claims.text: WhataHotel notes historic building constraints may mean smaller room sizes.
WhataHotel notes it is a small boutique property with limited room inventory.
